utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren, can you be there at 9 Saturday morning? We’ll start on the front porch and I’ll have the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, 9 works for me. I’ll be there on the front porch Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Sam. I’m still looking for a few more helpers for the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help out at the front porch this Saturday, Vik.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa. Can you come by at 9 Saturday morning and help sort tools and check people in?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I can be there at 9 Saturday morning to sort tools and check people in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I come by on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Around ten would be a big help. I’ll be on the front porch then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That would be great, Pia. I’ll put you on the small fixes and set you up when you arrive at 10.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, 10 works for me. I’ll bring my screwdriver and I’ll check in when I get there so I can see what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. Do you still need me to help?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, I still need a few more helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam. Could you help greet folks and keep the supplies organized when you arrive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa. I’ll greet folks and keep the supplies organized when I get there.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
